tasks.subject: Task 1: Build-time sitemap generator + repo cleanup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Produce a fresh `public/sitemap.xml` with 1004 URLs on every `next build`, replacing the hand-written file.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs`
- Modify: `package.json` (chain `prebuild` to call generator after snapshot)
- Modify: `.gitignore` (ignore `public/sitemap.xml`)
- Delete: `public/sitemap.xml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `pnpm run snapshot:colors && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs` writes `public/sitemap.xml` with exactly 1004 `<url>` entries.
- [ ] The 4 static URLs are: `https://colorone.site/`, `https://colorone.site/palettes`, `https://colorone.site/colors`, `https://colorone.site/privacy-policy`.
- [ ] Every color URL has the form `https://colorone.site/colors/<slug>` (no trailing slash).
- [ ] The root entry carries the two hero images (`/hero-tool.png`, `/hero-advance-harmony.png`) as `<image:image>` children; `/palettes` carries `/hero-advance-variations.png`; `xmlns:image` is declared on `<urlset>`.
- [ ] Static-route `<lastmod>` = today's date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); color-route `<lastmod>` = snapshot file mtime.
- [ ] Base URL respects `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` when set, falls back to `https://colorone.site` otherwise.
- [ ] `public/sitemap.xml` is removed from git tracking; `.gitignore` excludes it from future commits.
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds end-to-end with the new `prebuild` chain.

**Verify:** `pnpm build && grep -c '<url>' out/sitemap.xml` → `1004`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs", "package.json", ".gitignore", "public/sitemap.xml"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm build && grep -c '<url>' out/sitemap.xml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["public/sitemap.xml contains 1004 <url> entries", "4 static + 1000 color URLs present", "no trailing slashes on color URLs", "image annotations on / and /palettes", "lastmod uses snapshot mtime for colors and today for static", "public/sitemap.xml is gitignored and untracked", "pnpm build succeeds"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Build-time sitemap validator + postbuild wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fail the build (and therefore the GitHub Pages deploy) when the emitted sitemap is missing, malformed, or claims URLs the static export didn't produce.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/validate-sitemap.mjs`
- Modify: `package.json` (add `postbuild` script)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] After a clean `pnpm build`, the validator runs automatically and prints `✓ sitemap.xml: 1004 URLs, all reachable` with exit code 0.
- [ ] If `out/sitemap.xml` is deleted before the validator runs, the validator exits 1 with a clear message.
- [ ] If a `<loc>` references a path with no corresponding `out/<path>/index.html`, the validator exits 1 and prints the offending URL.
- [ ] If `out/robots.txt` is missing the sitemap URL, the validator exits 1.
- [ ] The validator's exit code propagates so a failure in CI prevents the Pages deploy step.

**Verify:** `pnpm build` exits 0 and prints the validator success line; injected failure cases exit 1 with the documented messages.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/validate-sitemap.mjs", "package.json"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["postbuild validator runs automatically and exits 0 on clean build", "validator exits 1 when sitemap missing", "validator exits 1 when URL has no corresponding HTML file", "validator exits 1 when robots.txt missing sitemap reference", "non-zero exit propagates to CI deploy gate"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Canonical tags on every route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every page in the static export emits a `<link rel="canonical">` matching its absolute URL.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/metadata.ts` (add canonical to root `Metadata`)
- Modify: `app/privacy-policy/page.tsx` (add canonical to its `Metadata`)
- Modify: `app/colors/page.tsx` (add canonical to its `Metadata`)
- Modify: `app/colors/[color_name]/page.tsx` (add canonical inside `generateMetadata`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `out/index.html` contains `<link rel="canonical" href="https://colorone.site"/>` (or with trailing slash — Next decides; either is fine as long as it's present and absolute).
- [ ] `out/privacy-policy/index.html` contains `<link rel="canonical" href="https://colorone.site/privacy-policy"/>`.
- [ ] `out/colors/index.html` contains `<link rel="canonical" href="https://colorone.site/colors"/>`.
- [ ] `out/colors/coral-red/index.html` contains `<link rel="canonical" href="https://colorone.site/colors/coral-red"/>`.
- [ ] `out/palettes/index.html` still contains its pre-existing canonical (unchanged).

**Verify:** `pnpm build && grep -o '<link rel="canonical"[^>]*/>' out/index.html out/privacy-policy/index.html out/colors/index.html out/colors/coral-red/index.html out/palettes/index.html` → five lines, each absolute URL.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/metadata.ts", "app/privacy-policy/page.tsx", "app/colors/page.tsx", "app/colors/[color_name]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm build && grep -o '<link rel=\"canonical\"[^>]*/>' out/index.html out/privacy-policy/index.html out/colors/index.html out/colors/coral-red/index.html out/palettes/index.html", "acceptanceCriteria": ["canonical present on /", "canonical present on /privacy-policy", "canonical present on /colors", "canonical present on /colors/coral-red with correct slug", "/palettes canonical unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Google Search Console operator checklist
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A reviewable, version-controlled runbook for the human operator covering one-time GSC setup, sitemap submission, post-deploy indexing verification, and the four failure modes the build validator cannot catch.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/seo-checklist.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] File covers: one-time property setup, sitemap submission, post-deploy indexing verification, coverage monitoring, and explicit out-of-scope items.
- [ ] References the exact sitemap path to submit (`sitemap.xml`) and the expected discovered URL count (≈1004).
- [ ] Names the four GSC failure modes the build validator cannot catch: Soft 404, Duplicate without user-selected canonical, Blocked by robots.txt, Page with redirect — each with a one-line "what this means in our codebase" pointer.

**Verify:** `test -f docs/seo-checklist.md && grep -c '^## ' docs/seo-checklist.md` → at least `5`.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/seo-checklist.md"], "verifyCommand": "test -f docs/seo-checklist.md && grep -c '^## ' docs/seo-checklist.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["file exists with at least 5 ## sections", "sitemap submission path documented as sitemap.xml with ~1004 URL count", "all four GSC failure modes named with codebase pointers"]}
```
